name: project-style
basis: User brief / rendered template / declared assumption
density: large core figure with short annotations

rules: Match the accepted reference's title hierarchy, figure size and annotation density; record observed slide numbers and measurements below
Keep required conditions, metric definitions and uncertainty visible; put full bibliographic locators in speaker notes
Use only supplied presenter metadata and an agreed opening, closing and backup policy

deck_structure.opening: Resolve from the brief or reference; do not invent presenter details
deck_structure.closing: Resolve from the brief or reference
deck_structure.backups: Resolve whether required, hidden in this file, separate, or omitted
